name: umaker
description: PBGD-based SSoT plugin for Claude Code. 4-phase pipeline (Plan/Build/Gatekeeping/Deploy), 10 agents, 29 um-* skills (/um-prepare umbrella, /um-analyze, /um-tools-figma analyzer + /um-tools-figma-screen + /um-tools-figma-ds writers, /um-build orchestrator, /um-gatekeeping, /um-deploy with interactive target + artifact selection, plus /um-createproject, /um-output, /um-doc (SSoT ingest + document reorganization), /um-reverse, /um-reports-roadmap (code-grounded interactive Gantt roadmap), um-tools-browser unified browser automation, and backward-compat aliases /um-init, /um-check, /um-qa, /um-ssot). Skills ship as frontmatter-only stubs — skill bodies are served by the u-maker terminal's embedded skills server. 11-criteria quality gate (pass ≥95, deploy-gate ≥98), continuous deploy regeneration, domain-split HTML output.
